propositions: Pathspec-scoped staging in commit_tickets_branch allows _commit_binding_store_snapshot to commit only the 5 allowlisted .bridge_state files without sweeping in dirty tracker files like last-pass.json.
Idempotent passes no longer advance tickets HEAD when only non-allowlisted files are dirty, because pathspec-scoped status reports no changes to the named files.

The new commit_tickets_branch seam preserves fail-open bool+alert contract by raising PushDeliveryError on lock/rebase/stage/commit failures, which existing handlers convert to False+stderr+bridge_alerts.
Per-file idempotency detection moves from basename checks to git status --porcelain with pathspec anchoring, enabling retirement-only passes to commit bindings-retired.json changes independently.
The raw-git-ok marker is removed because the locked seam with pathspec replaces raw git_adapter composition, and check_raw_git_writes.py passes.
